goal: Build a deterministic, fail-closed Current-Season PVE Universe and read-only differential audit so every required acquisition source and every discovered item relation is included, governed-excluded, or blocked before a Catalog can claim completeness.
userValue: Players can trust that the equipment simulator is not silently missing obtainable current-season PVE gear merely because an upstream source, page, cap, activity, or item relation never entered the existing staging tables.
nonGoals: Do not call or sync an external data source, write PostgreSQL, rebuild a Gear Release or Catalog, switch a Manifest pointer, deploy a candidate, or change the WeChat runtime in this slice.
Do not infer the source universe from observed player gear, the current Catalog, a 40-specialization projection, or aggregate counts.
Do not repair a discovered source gap in WebSim, the PG read model, or Taro; hand the gap to its actual discovery, ingestion, staging, or Catalog owner.

currentTruth.factOwner: A versioned source policy and independently captured official discovery snapshot own source-universe membership; staging and Catalog snapshots are downstream consumers checked by the reconciler.

mustChange: Add a versioned inclusive PVE acquisition-source policy with explicit authority, membership mode, effective window, and required status.

Keep core world-quest/rare/event equipment, Midnight Renown power-gear vendors, and the Chiming Void Curio tier-set vendor transform as separate required source owners rather than hiding them inside raid or Revelations world-content rows.
Add a pure deterministic reconciler that binds exact season/source-policy revisions and emits one included, excluded, or blocked outcome for every known source and item relation.
Bind item-relation identity to canonical progressionState and reject empty, expired, evidenceless, or malformed source membership so track/rank/projection states cannot silently collapse.
Bind every verified discovery source to the exact authority-reference set declared by the source policy; an unrelated or partial authority set remains blocked.

Represent missing source discovery, expired evidence, caps, pagination gaps, fetch failures, fallbacks, staging omissions, Catalog omissions, and identity conflicts as machine-readable blocked ledger entries.
Represent every staging/Catalog relation absent from independent discovery exactly once as a downstream-only blocker.
Require governed exclusions to carry a stable reason code, fact owner, evidence reference, and decision time.
Add bounded read-only JSON snapshot/report adapters and tests; report output must not dump unbounded source payloads to journald.
Record the current real staging/source-policy mismatch without upgrading same-source Catalog consistency to completeness.
mustNotChange: No network fetch, dependency install, database write, source sync, Catalog build, candidate deployment, active pointer, timer, persisted player data, or public payload change.
No frontend fallback, name-based item inference, observed-profile ownership, or empty-source-as-success behavior.
No completeness claim while any required source or relation is blocked, stale, capped, failed, paginated incompletely, or revision-mismatched.
riskUnknown: Some current-season PVE acquisition paths may expose reward pools through in-game or DBC structures rather than one Blizzard Game Data endpoint.
Great Vault, Catalyst, Voidforge, crafted, vendor, and time-bounded event sources may project or transform another item pool rather than own a distinct item list.
The current production season state is expired and current staging source types do not cover every official current-season PVE acquisition path.
evidenceRequired: RED/GREEN unit tests for source omission, cap/fetch/pagination/fallback gaps, staging/Catalog difference, governed exclusion completeness, revision drift, and deterministic ordering.
A bounded read-only current-state report whose blocked source members and item differences are explicit.
Harness requirement/packet validation, targeted tests, git diff check, and local CR.

ownership.factOwner: server/season_pve_universe.py owns canonical reconciliation only; the versioned source-policy artifact owns required acquisition paths; official discovery, staging, and Catalog snapshots retain their own evidence owners.

engineeringHealth.reason: The current same-source 40-specialization shadow cannot detect upstream source omissions, production season evidence is expired, and cloud disk pressure forbids using a new sync/candidate as a shortcut. This slice is pure and read-only.

acceptanceEvidence: Every required source-policy member is independently verified or produces an explicit blocked ledger row; missing discovery is never treated as an empty source.
Every discovered item relation has exactly one included, governed-excluded, or blocked outcome.
Every required source has a positive minimum member count and valid evidence window; empty or expired membership cannot claim verified.
Canonical progressionState participates in relation identity and downstream-only members absent from discovery block verification.
Caps, pagination cursors, fetch failures, fallbacks, expired evidence, and revision mismatch block the report with stable reason codes.
A governed exclusion without reason, owner, evidence, or decision time is rejected.
Canonical input order does not change SeasonPveUniverseRevision.
The real current-state audit does not claim completeness from the existing Catalog or 40/40 same-source projection.
No external fetch, database write, Catalog/Manifest mutation, candidate deployment, timer change, or public/WeChat runtime change occurs.

decisionLog.decision: The user's complete-equipment Goal requires an independent current-season PVE source universe; same-source 40-specialization projection and sample UI checks cannot prove it.
Official Midnight Season 1 materials identify PVE acquisition paths beyond the current dungeon/raid staging policy, so missing source discovery is a release blocker rather than an empty verified set.

harnessFindings.whatHappened: The Catalog shadow reported 40/40 specialization mapping from the same staging source but had no independent source-universe reconciliation.
harnessFindings.impact: A source, instance, encounter, difficulty, or item omitted before staging could never appear in the shadow difference and could be silently absent from the player library.
harnessFindings.recommendedAction: Require a versioned source-policy snapshot and exact include/exclude/blocked ledger before any future Catalog completeness claim.
